cells.gaps: No source held since October 2023 says the country takes part in PAPSS or a regional payment system.
cells.note: The Bank of Mozambique supervises the national switch and launched the Metix instant payment system in March 2026. No regional link is held. Mozambique joined PAPSS in September 2026 (MOZ-008), with banks invited to onboard, but no live participation is held, and accession alone is not counted.
